question: Which material asset interests can be attributed to Northstar from the supplied record, and what type of interest does each record actually establish?

interests.assessment: The supplied land-register fixture records Northstar Components GmbH as legal owner of the property.
The same fixture records a synthetic mortgage/security interest in favour of Borealis Bank AG. A security interest is not ownership.
An operating-permit fixture places Northstar Operations GmbH at the site. Occupation/use is not legal ownership.
The lease schedule records Arcadia Leasing GmbH as owner of the production line.
Northstar has contractual use of the production line but is not established as its legal owner.

sources.title: Synthetic land-register extract — Leipzig Distribution Centre

analyst_assessment: The supplied record establishes legal ownership of the Leipzig property by Northstar, subject to a security interest, while a related operating company uses the site. For the production line, the evidence establishes use through a lease rather than ownership. These distinctions prevent asset tracing from inflating a subject's asset base by treating occupation, use, financing or group association as ownership.
guardrails: Do not infer beneficial ownership of an asset from use or possession alone.
Do not treat a lender's security interest as legal ownership.
Do not attribute assets across a corporate group without an evidenced relationship to the specific asset.
Preserve asset identifiers and as-of dates so later transfers can be distinguished from current ownership.
For real engagements, confirm current authoritative records and lawful access before consequential use.
